versions.content: If KeyMCryptoKeyVerifyAsyncMode is set to TRUE, the function will run in asynchronous mode. The direct function call will return KEYM_E_PENDING if the job was accepted or any other return value if the job could not be accepted. In asynchronous mode, the KeyM_CryptoKeyVerifyCallbackNotification will provide the result of the crypto job operation.
